rubric.role_summary: On-site experimental physicist in Palo Alto working with entropy sources and superconducting hardware, responsible for tracing measured outputs to their physical origins.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
On-site experimental physicist in Palo Alto working with entropy sources and superconducting hardware, responsible for tracing measured outputs to their physical origins.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- A Master's degree or an equivalent experimental record in experimental physics, quantum optics, or precision measurement.
- Experimental experience in quantum hardware, precision metrology, gravitational-wave detection, or optical systems.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- PhD.
- ML on measurement streams.
- Optical bench experience with lasers, photodetectors, fiber, and their noise physics.
- Hands-on superconducting qubit measurement, including coherence measurements, dispersive readout, and microwave control.
- Microwave signal-chain fluency in IQ mixing, heterodyne readout, and pulse shaping.
- Depth in TLS physics, flux noise, readout crosstalk, or amplifier-chain characterization.
- A record of tracing measurement-chain noise to its physical origins in quantum hardware, precision metrology, gravitational-wave detection, or optical systems.
- Time-series and spectral analysis covering periodicities, non-stationarity, and correlations.
- Knowledge of analog front-end and data-acquisition artifacts, including photodetector and amplifier noise, ADC and clock behavior, grounding, and EMI.
- Experience characterizing or validating entropy sources or randomness generation.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory.
